dialogue.lost_realm.lord.line.1: Another one, crawling in through the rift…
dialogue.lost_realm.lord.line.2: This city is older than your world. Its name has long been forgotten — even by me.
dialogue.lost_realm.lord.line.3: I have waited a long time. Long enough that only this husk remains — and a will that refuses to scatter.
dialogue.lost_realm.lord.line.4: You may leave; I won't stop you. If you stay to duel… then let me finish: you cannot beat me.
dialogue.lost_realm.lord.line.brief: You again. I will not repeat myself — leave, or fight?
item.lost_realm.lost_realm_fragment.tip: A shard of some long-collapsed place, still humming.
item.lost_realm.warden_scythe: Reaper Scythe of the Lost Lord

item.lost_realm.warden_echo.tip.1: It echoes inside your pack, like a sentence left unfinished.
item.lost_realm.warden_echo.tip.2: §7Can be broken down into 2 Lost Fragments in a crafting table.
item.lost_realm.warden_scythe.tip.1: A pitch-black crescent blade, its edge still wet with blood.
item.lost_realm.warden_scythe.tip.2: §7The weapon the Lost Lord wields himself - it remembers all who refused to kneel.

message.lost_realm.altar.apotheosis.hint: §7Land a devastating critical hit, and let it hear itself crack.
message.lost_realm.altar.medal.hint: §7Hit it while a medal ability is active.
message.lost_realm.altar.pure.hint: §7Strip off every enchantment and medal — touch it with a pure strike.
message.lost_realm.altar.soul.hint: §7Strike the Lord with Goety magic to pour souls into the altar.
message.lost_realm.key.ignited: §5A rift tears open. §7Step through and meet the Lord.
message.lost_realm.key.no_room: §cNot enough space to open a rift here.
message.lost_realm.lord.defeated: §5The Lord finally stops. §7The Lost City begins to crumble — and this time, no one comes.
message.lost_realm.lord.duel.leave: §7You turn back toward the rift. §8Behind you, a sigh barely worth hearing.
message.lost_realm.lord.duel.too_weak: §c"You are far too weak. Go train, then come back and duel me."
message.lost_realm.lord.duel.trial_done: §5"Still standing... good." §7He sheathes the blade and melts into the dark — §8the trial ends here.
message.lost_realm.lord.lock: §cIts shell cracks — §5its life is pinned to the last sliver. §7It begins to reknit itself, §fnow's your window! §7(potions / reposition / cooldowns)
message.lost_realm.lord.reappear: §5"A passing start, at best." §cThe Lord steps down from the dais.
message.lost_realm.lord.waves.begin: §5The Lord withdraws into the dais. §7Shadows pour out from the depths of the city — §fclear them all.
message.lost_realm.lord.waves.cleared: §7The last wave is cleared. §8The flagstones tremble beneath you…
message.lost_realm.realm.locked: §cA fight is underway — and you are not part of it.
message.lost_realm.resonance.granted: §d[Quest Chain] §fFour-fold resonance achieved. The Lost City takes notice of you.
message.lost_realm.skill.judgement.begin: §4Final Judgement begins — end it before the cast completes.
message.lost_realm.skill.soul_drain.succ: §cSoul drain complete. It has grown harder to wound.
message.lost_realm.skill.soul_drain.warn: §5The Lord begins to drain souls — interrupt it!
message.lost_realm.warden.defeated: §5The Lord of the Lost Realm dissolves. The Lost City returns to silence.
